verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own Docs & Files tool keeps documents, PDFs, images and cloud files (Google Docs, Figma, Dropbox) organized inside each project, so shared docs sit alongside project work. The evidence does not clearly show native authoring of docs or notes; rich-text content is described only generically in the API docs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of creating and editing native docs/notes, folder or organization depth, collaborative editing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work

citations.quote: Docs & Files keeps images, documents, PDFs, even cloud files from Figma, Google Docs, and Dropbox neatly organized inside your projects.
Rich text content may contain lists, block quotes, simple formatting, and inline attachments such as mentions, images, and files.
